authority: explainable evaluation and presentation only; this registry and its implementation grant no authority

transition_semantics.INELIGIBLE: one or more action-specific evidence groups are not satisfied
transition_semantics.ELIGIBLE: eligibility evidence is satisfied; required review is pending
transition_semantics.REVIEWED: eligibility and review are satisfied; an explicit bounded grant is pending
transition_semantics.GRANTED: bounded authority exists; registered execution prerequisites are incomplete
transition_semantics.ACTIVE: eligibility, review, grant, registered action, destination acceptance, and lifecycle checks are satisfied
transition_semantics.SUSPENDED: a bounded grant exists but has been suspended
transition_semantics.EXPIRED: a bounded grant existed but its validity window has expired

forbidden_authority_inputs: icosahedron, junction, or ARCnet geometric alignment

geometry_presentation.law: A Morph May Explain a Permission Boundary; It May Not Execute One.
